description: This file implements the Bluetooth HCI (Host Controller Interface) service, including initialization, data transmission, and packet handling for Bluetooth communication in an Android environment. It manages serial communication with the Bluetooth controller, handles threading for packet reading, and interfaces with Android's binder IPC mechanism.

classes.name: Idc
classes.description: Enumeration representing different packet types for Bluetooth HCI communication.

classes.name: ClientState
classes.description: Enum representing the state of the Bluetooth HCI client connection.

classes.name: ServiceState
classes.description: Struct holding the writer file handle and client state for the Bluetooth HCI service.

classes.name: BluetoothHci
classes.description: Main class managing Bluetooth HCI communication, including thread handling and data transmission.
